item.title: Apple HomeView
item.description: Apple HomeView is a smart display with Siri AI, Liquid Retina display, high-fidelity audio, FaceTime, smart home controls, built-in privacy, and more. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: An hour of audio transcribed in about 13s on MacBook Air
item.description: Google's EmbeddingGemma 2, turned into a speech-to-text model. An hour of audio in about 13 seconds on a base MacBook Air, entirely on device. Free Mac app. (1 source: hackernews)

Can Ease of Creation Lead to Decrease in Quality & Value?
item.description: Why does so much new music sound the same? Why does a song feel almost worthless when you can stream every album ever recorded for the price of one CD? And... is software next? (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: The reverts will continue until morale improves
item.description: Many readers will be aware that an unusually high number of features have been reverted from the PostgreSQL 19 branch after the beta period began. Having some reverts is not unusual, maybe one per cycle could be expected. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Lotus Improv on the NeXT
